ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio approximately 0.8:1 white-to-black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black pigmentation extends from the peduncle base to the median notch in a broad 'V' shape; high-intensity white regions occupy the lateral lobes with significant black mottling and speckling concentrated near the central boundary and outer margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire span; jagged margin with peak amplitudes of 10-15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes; right lobe terminates in a sharp, pointed distal tip; left lobe terminates in a blunt, irregular truncated margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete dark circular pixel clusters on the left white lobe; high-intensity white textured clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear streaks and rake marks intersecting the central black pigmentation zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular truncation and missing tissue at the far-left fluke tip compared to the symmetrical pointed right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellow-brown chromatic staining (diatom film) visible across the upper horizontal axis of the white regions on both lobes.
